variant_remarks.quote: ‏ وحدثنا موسى قال حدثنا وهيب قال مسح رأسه مرة‏

notes: the saying describes the Prophet's wudu, given in a scene where عمرو بن أبي حسن سأل عبد الله بن زيد; Abdullah b. Zayd is in the scene and his action is described, so he is not added (rule 6); whether he is the last link is not settled by the rules
أبيه with no name is a relation link (rule 7); the father's name is not in this report
group 2 names a different first transmitter (Musa) for a fragment of the same saying (head wiped once): a variant (rule 4); no tail, because the text does not repeat the first branch's names
شهدت is the first-person witness of the father, not a further link

ruling needed (rule 11): «شهدت عمرو بن أبي حسن سأل عبد الله بن زيد عن وضوء النبي» is a narrated encounter in which Abdullah b. Zayd speaks and acts; the father's witness is the last link written; whether Abdullah is a link too is not settled
«عمرو بن أبي حسن» asks inside the father's story: in the scene, not a link (rule 5)
the second isnad «وحدثنا موسى قال حدثنا وهيب قال مسح رأسه مرة» carries a different saying (wiping the head once); it is not a route for this saying and is held out (rules 4, 11)
«أبيه» is bare: a relation link (rule 7); the names other sources give for it are not written
